page.overview:
Who is Gundahar Bolger?

Gundahar Bolger was a hobbit of the Shire.

Gundahar was born in TA 2774 (SR 1174) to Gundolpho Bolger and Alfrida of the Yale. He had two siblings: Gundahad and Rudolph Bolger. He married Dina Diggle and they had two children, Adalgar and Adaldrida Brandybuck. He died in TA 2875 (SR 1275).
